text: The urinalysis shows sterile pyuria and significant hematuria, which raises suspicion for tuberculosis or a malignancy despite the normal CT. REQUEST TEST: Urine culture and acid-fast bacilli (AFB) smear, along with a chest X-ray to rule out pulmonary tuberculosis.
